t: FastHTML WebSockets & Database for Streaming & Persistence
s: This article details porting capabilities from Pipulate to Botifython, focusing on simplifying web development with FastHTML's integrated WebSockets and database persistence, particularly within a Nix Flake environment for multi-platform compatibility. It highlights overcoming challenges with local LLM integration (Ollama) on Windows via WSL and emphasizes a streamlined development approach.
sub: Porting Pipulate to Botifython using FastHTML framework.
Multi-platform development and testing on Windows (WSL), macOS, and Linux.
Integrating Ollama LLM with WSL on Windows for local AI capabilities.
Streamlining development with Nix Flakes and FastHTML for web apps.
